summary: Iteration 6: Verified Welcome-email (Resend, placeholder key -> logged), Stripe Billing Portal endpoint, and can_manage gating on /pricing. BACKEND (pytest 7/7 in /app/backend/tests/test_billing_portal.py + 18/18 regression in test_billing.py + test_password_reset.py, ALL 25 PASS): (1) POST /api/auth/register with origin_url returns 200 and produces a backend log line 'squawkking - WARNING - [welcome] Resend not configured (placeholder key). Would send \'Welcome to Squawk King IA\' to <email>' within ~1.5s (asyncio.create_task+asyncio.to_thread); (2) GET /api/billing/status returns can_manage=false for a freshly registered trial user (no stripe_customer_id in Mongo); (3) GET /api/billing/status returns can_manage=true after we set users.stripe_customer_id via Mongo update; (4) POST /api/billing/portal without Bearer returns 401; (5) POST /api/billing/portal for a user with no stripe_customer_id returns 400 detail 'No active subscription to manage. Choose a plan first.'; (6) POST /api/billing/portal for a user with a REAL stripe.Customer.create test customer + tier=basic+status=active returns 200 with portal_url starting 'https://billing.stripe.com/'; (7) demo <demo-admin-email-redacted>/<redacted> login still returns 200, billing status plan=unlimited allowed=true can_manage=false (admin has no stripe_customer_id set). Regression suite (test_billing.py 12/12 + test_password_reset.py 8/8) unchanged: /billing/plans shape (3 plans, trial_days=3), trial user allowed + can chat SSE, expired-trial 402 'free trial has ended', Basic exhausted 402 'token', /payments/checkout returns real checkout.stripe.com URL for all 3 lookup_keys, unknown lookup 400, no-auth 401, /auth/forgot-password generic response + no enumeration + rate limit 429 on 4th, /auth/reset-password happy path + reuse-rejected + short-password 400, /auth/change-password. FRONTEND (Playwright, 4/4 scenarios PASS): [A] Fresh trial user via /login->register (auth-toggle) -> workspace -> /pricing shows current-plan-line='Free trial · 3 days left', subscribe-basic/pro/unlimited all present, manage-subscription count=0 (NOT rendered). [B] Login as user with real stripe_customer_id (via prep: stripe.Customer.create + Mongo update) -> /pricing shows current-plan-line='Current plan: basic · 5 tokens left', manage-subscription visible=true; click triggers POST /api/billing/portal->200 and full-page nav to https://billing.stripe.com/p/session?secret=test_... — Stripe Sandbox portal actually loaded end-to-end (screenshot shows 'squawk-king-ia partners with Stripe for simplified billing' with the subscriber's email + 'Return to squawk-king-ia' back-link). [C] Demo login <demo-admin-email-redacted>/<redacted> -> workspace loads with UNLIMITED badge; /pricing shows current-plan-line='Current plan: unlimited', manage-subscription count=0 for admin (no stripe_customer_id); direct fetch of /api/billing/status returns plan=unlimited, can_manage=false, allowed=true. [D] Fresh UI registration produces welcome log 'Would send Welcome to Squawk King IA to uireg_<hex>@example.com'. Placeholder RESEND_API_KEY behavior is per spec — do NOT report 'no email delivered' as a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py billing_portal(): return_url fallback is `os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS','').split(',')[0]` — with CORS_ORIGINS='*' in dev, this falls back to '*' which Stripe would reject as an invalid URL. In practice the frontend always sends window.location.href, so this branch never triggers, but consider defaulting to the frontend origin or raising 400 when both req.return_url and a valid fallback are absent.

server.py register(): welcome-email task is fired via asyncio.create_task(asyncio.to_thread(...)) without awaiting the task or attaching an error handler. If Resend raises unexpectedly (e.g., transient network), the exception is swallowed. Fine for a fire-and-forget welcome, but consider `.add_done_callback(...)` to log unhandled exceptions.

PricingPlans.jsx openPortal(): sets portalLoading=true, but if the API succeeds and window.location.href navigation is fast, the loading spinner may flash briefly. UX-fine; a low-priority polish would be to keep portalLoading=true through unload.

PricingPlans.jsx openPortal(): the toast on error uses formatApiErrorDetail(err.response?.data?.detail); the 400 detail 'No active subscription to manage. Choose a plan first.' will surface correctly, but the button is already gated behind can_manage=true so this path should be unreachable. Consider removing the fallback text 'Could not open billing portal' or keeping it as a safety net (current choice is OK).
Login.jsx switchMode does not clear name/password when toggling between login/register — password state persists in memory (also flagged prior iteration). Minor.

server.py _send_email(): places the log line at WARNING level even for the expected placeholder-key path — that pollutes WARN logs in dev. Consider INFO for placeholder-key fallback and reserving WARNING for real send failures.
server.py PortalRequest.return_url is a plain string (no HttpUrl validation). Stripe will 400 for malformed URLs; consider Pydantic HttpUrl to fail fast client-side.
